## What's changed

- Stops Tube TV encoding immediately when a paired player reports that playback stopped or completed, instead of continuing to process an abandoned channel.
- Prevents late playlist reloads from recreating a Tube TV session after the viewer backs out.
- Ties modern Tube TV playback URLs to the current server process so a cached request from before a quick restart cannot resurrect the old channel.
- Extends the paired-player stop endpoint to release Tube TV and local HLS playback resources as well as tracked streams.
- Preserves shared channel encoders while another player is still watching and adds regression coverage for stop, restart, and intentional replay behavior.
- Adds HLS as a Tater Core playback option while retaining MPEG-TS as the default, including the selected container and media type in playback responses.
- Keeps Tater Core's temporary, path-scoped authorization attached to HLS segment requests so Echo-screen playback remains secure throughout the stream.
